description: This file is a shell script used for testing the bitmap functionality in a Git-like version control system. It includes setup routines, tests for bitmap creation, validation, error handling, and boundary traversal behavior, as well as tests for pack reuse and delta relationships.

methods.name: objpath
methods.description: Constructs the object path for a given SHA-like hash.

methods.name: list_packed_objects
methods.description: Lists objects present in a pack given its index file.

methods.name: has_any
methods.description: Checks if content-file has any entry from pattern-file.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Prepares a test repository with a specific commit history for bitmap testing.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Verifies if a delta object is stored against a base object.
